description: What the main window may do. Start from nothing and add permissions one at a time, as features need them. core:window:allow-start-dragging: the sidebar's top row is the title bar (titleBarStyle Overlay), so dragging it must move the window. Files dropped from Finder arrive through core:default's webview drag-drop events. dialog:allow-open: the native panel for Upload…, choosing a private key and choosing a download folder.
